recommended_steps.detail: Whether the two-second post-readiness deadline should stay a host-sensitive assertion in the native lane is yours to decide.
recommended_steps.title: Judge the post-readiness deadline

recommended_steps.detail: On the clean release commit and qualifying host run ./bin/check all, ./bin/check native and ./bin/check release; a tag needs CHECK RELEASE VERIFIED.
recommended_steps.title: Native qualification before a release

what_just_landed.detail: Each positive native watcher proof starts its clock only after an ignored canary file has been delivered by the native callback and dispatched by the handler.
what_just_landed.title: Readiness before every native deadline

what_just_landed.detail: A missed deadline reports whether the target was natively absent, late or stalled after a named stage, and whether an overflow flag was seen; the original failure always stands.
what_just_landed.title: Failure-only stage notes

what_just_landed.detail: The injected handler exception is armed after readiness, fires only for the first workload file and must be raised exactly once.
what_just_landed.title: Stronger recovery proof
